opening.argument: The video presents a self-deployed Ethereum bot as an easy source of daily passive income, then directs viewers to fund its contract with at least 0.2 ETH. It expressly links larger deposits to greater accumulated profit and reports 31% profit in about twelve hours, while portraying withdrawal as returning the deposit plus profit. The deployed-contract panel visibly includes start and withdrawal controls, reinforcing that viewers are being guided through an actual contract interaction. Those features establish a solicitation for trading-bot returns, although the frames do not independently prove that the reported returns were generated or that deposited funds were withdrawn.
